Questions 27-30 
 
What comment is made about the programme for each of the following shows? 
 
Choose FOUR answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-F, next to 
Questions 27-30. 
 
Show                                                        Comments about programme  
 
27 Ruy Blas     …………                            A. I origin is somewhat controversial 
 
28 Man of La Mancha     …………            B. It is historically significant for a country. 
 
29 The Tragedy of Jane Shore   ..………  C. It was effective at attracting audiences 
 
30 The Sailors' Festival      ………..          D. It is included in a recent project 
 
                                                                  E. It contains insights into the show 
  
                                                                  F. It resembles an artwork.
